name: Suzuki GS650
engine: 673 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs (G models shaft drive, E models chain)
intro: A capable early-80s four. Most are shaft-drive G models. The basics of carbs, valves and air leaks matter most.

E: The G is shaft drive. The rarer E is chain drive and shares little else with the G.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: G vs E
known.what: The G is the common model. The chain-drive E is rare and quite different.
